channel.title: Startup Bulletin
channel.description: Startup stories, AI strategy and company explainers. Published by the Metricify AI team.

item.title: Larry Ellison’s AI bet: what Stargate means for startups
item.description: Historical perspective: January 6, 2026. Retrospective published November 8, 2026. Oracle’s role in the AI infrastructure buildout is a different kind of venture: the race to supply the computing capacity behind the products.

item.title: Is the AI bubble bursting? Ask which layer you mean
item.description: Historical perspective: January 22, 2026. Retrospective published November 8, 2026. AI demand, company valuations and infrastructure returns can move in different directions. A framework for reading the debate without a crash prediction.

item.title: Mistral’s open-model strategy: more choice, more responsibility
item.description: Historical perspective: December 8, 2025. Retrospective published November 8, 2026. A look at the Mistral 3 release and the trade-offs founders face when choosing between hosted APIs and models they can deploy themselves.

item.title: What Anthropic’s usage research can—and cannot—tell founders
item.description: Historical perspective: December 18, 2025. Retrospective published November 8, 2026. Claude conversations reveal patterns in AI use. Turning those patterns into a product strategy requires care about the sample, the task and the outcome.

item.title: Metricify AI: a January 2026 commerce perspective (promotional retrospective)
item.description: Historical perspective: January 12, 2026. Retrospective published November 8, 2026. A promotional introduction from the publisher’s company.
